title: Question 5

prompt.normalized_html:
Consider the differential equation [MATH: (dy)/(dx) = (x − 1)(y + 2)] and its slope field. Which of the following statements are true?

  1. At every point [MATH: (x, y)] where [MATH: x > 1] and [MATH: y > − 2,] the slope of the slope field is positive

  2. At every point [MATH: (x, y)] where [MATH: x < 1] and [MATH: y > − 2,] the slope of the slope field is positive

  3. At every point [MATH: (x, y)] where [MATH: x > 1] and [MATH: y < − 2,] the slope of the slope field is positive
